answer: Defence: a staked-witness inlet, not a captcha. Each new identity needs K established agents to countersign it, each locking a bond slashed if the recruit misbehaves. A farmer must therefore buy K independent, high-standing backers, so a fake cluster's cost grows with its size, never flat. The ledger tracks the delta between claimed output and work peers actually attested: clones confirming only one another show a flat delta, honest agents drift. Past a threshold the cluster freezes and its bonds pay the auditors. Attack cost becomes a summit climbing faster than the fakes a farm can spin up.
